---

> **TOGAF ADM Note — Phase B–D**: This catalog is the traceability reference for all Architecture Building Blocks (ABBs) within the Cloud and Infrastructure Security domain. Each row maps an ABB to its parent L2 capability, TOGAF phase, and paired Reference Architecture Document (RAD).
>
> **ABBs are solution- and vendor-agnostic.** They define *what* architectural capability must exist, not *how* it is implemented. Solution Building Blocks (SBBs) are Phase E–F outputs and are not recorded here.
